preferences.title: Title of the Preferences window.
preferences.sections.theme: Section of Preferences for colours and palettes. Not the same as the Theme field (light or dark).
preferences.sections.data: Section of Preferences about stored data and backups.
preferences.fields.theme: Label of the choice between System, Light and Dark.
preferences.fields.contrast: How strongly borders and secondary text are drawn.
preferences.fields.density: How tightly rows and controls are spaced.
preferences.fields.responseLayout: Where the response panel sits relative to the request: below it or to its right.
preferences.themes.system: Follow the operating system's light or dark setting.
preferences.contrasts.more: A higher contrast level, not a quantity.
preferences.layouts.below: Response panel is placed under the request.
preferences.layouts.right: Response panel is placed to the right of the request.
preferences.seconds: Unit shown after a number input, as in 30 seconds.
preferences.pixels: Unit shown after a number input; keep px.
preferences.accentAdjusted: {{light}} and {{dark}} are names of colours in the same family.
preferences.defaultFont: Placeholder of a font input when no font is chosen.
preferences.timeoutHint: {{count}} is the built-in limit in seconds. 0 means no custom timeout.
preferences.languageSystem: First option of the Language list. {{language}} is the language the system picked, written in its own name.
preferences.languageSwitch: Button that saves the language and reloads the app.
preferences.languageHelp: {{link}} is replaced by a link whose text is languageHelpLink. The full stop after it belongs to this sentence.
preferences.languageHelpLink: Link text. Opens the GitHub issue where people request languages and report translations.
preferences.reset: Button that restores every preference to its default.
preferences.close: Button that closes the Preferences window. Keep it short.
preferences.statusLabel: Label of the status bar item that opens Preferences.
preferences.methods.method: Column heading: the HTTP method (GET, POST, ...).
preferences.theme.sample: Sample of text shown in the chosen colours. Use letters that look like typical text in your script.
preferences.theme.colorLabel: Accessible label of a colour input. {{surface}} is a part of the window such as Sidebar, {{role}} is background or text.
preferences.theme.hexLabel: Accessible label of a hex colour input. Same placeholders as the colour label.
preferences.theme.ratio: A contrast ratio such as 4.5:1. Keep the colon and 1.
preferences.theme.roles.background: Lowercase word used inside colour labels.
preferences.theme.roles.foreground: Lowercase word used inside colour labels; it means text colour.
preferences.theme.columns.contrast: Column heading of the contrast ratio between text and background.
preferences.theme.import: Button that opens the field for pasting a theme. Not the verb for the Import feature of requests.
preferences.theme.apply: Button that applies a pasted theme.
preferences.themes.light: Name of the light colour theme.
preferences.themes.dark: Name of the dark colour theme.
preferences.contrasts.system: Choice that follows the operating system setting for contrast.
preferences.theme.palettes.default: Name of the standard colour palette.
preferences.theme.columns.reset: Column heading above the buttons that restore a colour to its default.
preferences.languageTranslate: Second sentence under the Language list. {{link}} is the link text from languageTranslateLink and opens the Gostman project on Weblate, where people translate the app.
preferences.languageTranslateLink: Name of the translation platform. Keep Weblate as written.
